description: Create a new Scheduled Maintenance State Timeline in OneUptime. Returns the created Scheduled Maintenance State Timeline object with its ID. Use this to add new Scheduled Maintenance State Timelines to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

endsAt.description: When did this status change end?

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

scheduledMaintenanceId.description: ID of Scheduled Maintenance this resource belongs to.

scheduledMaintenanceStateId.description: Scheduled Maintenance State ID. Which state does this event belongs to?

shouldStatusPageSubscribersBeNotified.description: Should subscribers be notified about this state change?

startsAt.description: When did this status change? Correct this when the recorded time is wrong - every measurement derived from this timeline is recomputed from the corrected value.
